process: Discover — understand your business and the real problem
Understand — find the root challenge, not just the request
Strategize — recommend the right solution, even if it differs from what was asked
Build — design, develop, test with transparency
Grow — long-term support and continuous improvement
whyChoose: One partner across web, AI, immersive and emerging tech — no juggling vendors
Founder-led — direct oversight on strategy and quality
We recommend the solution that fits the problem, not the one that is easiest to sell
Real, verifiable projects — not stock case studies

chips.teamWastes: My team wastes time on repetitive work
chips.needSee: People need to "see" a space before visiting

responses.showProcess: Here's how a project runs, start to finish:
responses.unsureFlow: No problem — quick way to narrow it down. Which sounds closest?
responses.escalateUrgent: This sounds like something worth a quick, specific conversation. {founder} can usually give you a real number faster than I can.
responses.escalateHandoff: Want me to connect you with {founder} directly? Fastest way to get exact pricing for your project.
responses.contactResponse: Sure — easiest way is WhatsApp, usually a reply within minutes. Or call directly if you'd rather talk it through.
responses.greetingRepeat: Hey! What are you looking to do — build something, automate something, or showcase something?
responses.fallback: I want to point you to the right place rather than guess — which of these is closest to what you need?

fallbackChips: Just let me talk to someone

whatsappMessage.urgent: This is fairly time-sensitive for me.
